instruction: Start with /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-11_input.step. On the 145 x 85 x 10 mm base plate, add and fuse two locating pins and one rectangular key. The first pin is diameter 10 mm, height 24 mm, centered at (35,25), starting on Z=10. The second pin is diameter 14 mm, height 18 mm, centered at (110,60), starting on Z=10. The rectangular key spans X=66..82, Y=12..24, Z=10..20. Cut vertical through holes in the base at (35,60) with diameter 6 mm and at (110,25) with diameter 7 mm. Cut a through obround lightening slot centered at (72,45), length 54 mm along X and width 16 mm. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-11_output.step. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH). On this machine, use `/usr/lib/freecad/bin/freecadcmd-python3` for the FreeCAD command-line work in this task when working on `freecad_task-11_input.step`.
